{"tool":"python","code":"from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill, Border, Side

ws_test = wb['Test']
ws_master = wb['master']

# Collect yellow non-blank cells from Test column A
yellow_values = []
for r in range(1, 64):
    c = ws_test.cell(row=r, column=1)
    fill = c.fill
    fg = fill.fgColor
    if fill.patternType == 'solid' and fg.type == 'rgb' and fg.rgb == 'FFFFFF00':
        if c.value is not None and str(c.value).strip() != '':
            yellow_values.append(c.value)

print("Yellow non-blank values:", len(yellow_values))
for i, v in enumerate(yellow_values):
    print(i+1, v)

# Yellow fill and border
yellow_fill = PatternFill(start_color='FFFF00', end_color='FFFF00', fill_type='solid')
thin = Side(style='thin')
border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)

# Clear A1:AH1 first
for col in range(1, 35):
    cell = ws_master.cell(row=1, column=col)
    cell.value = None
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type=None)
    cell.border = Border()

# Fill with yellow values
for i, v in enumerate(yellow_values):
    cell = ws_master.cell(row=1, column=i+1)
    cell.value = v
    cell.fill = yellow_fill
    cell.border = border

print("Filled", len(yellow_values), "cells in master row 1")"}
